chunks: Surely those who slander Our signs are not hidden from Us. Then, is he better who will be cast into Hell, or he who will come out safe on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will, He sees whatsoever you do.

key_terms.يُلْحِدُونَ: to distort or slant away from the truth

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Do what you will' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from divine observation to divine recompense, where 'Do what you will' (I'ma'malu ma shi'tum) is interpreted not as a dismissal but as an emphasis on the certainty of accountability for every deed. The contrast between 'Alidun' (those who distort) and 'Amiman' (secure) underscores the ultimate fate of the faithful versus the disfigured, reinforcing the concept of divine justice (Adl) where God's sight precedes and dictates the outcome. This serves as a profound reminder that human agency is real but always within the scope of God's all-encompassing knowledge.
